title: Carrier configuration guide
story: As a carrier configurator I can set up the platform without code by following docs/configuration-guide.md.
acceptance: docs/configuration-guide.md walks the tenant document section by section with snippets copied verbatim from tenants/aurelia-mutual.json and tenants/kestrel-point.json

Has how-to sections for: add line of business, add state with regulatory timers, question with showIf, STP rule, routing queue, AI provider settings (local vs Claude/Gemini on Vertex), webhooks and adapter mapping profiles
Covers POST /config/validate, If-Match versioning, admin console walkthrough and a Common mistakes section
Every field name and endpoint cited exists in the schema, src or docs/api-reference.md (reviewer spot-checks 5)
Only synthetic fictional tenants; no capability claimed that code lacks
brief: Write docs/configuration-guide.md only. Read tenants/*.json, architecture/contracts/domain/TenantConfig.schema.json, docs/api-reference.md, docs/setup.md, src/web admin app and the config module in src to confirm real field names, endpoints and admin console screens before documenting. Use real snippets, copied exactly from the tenant files; do not invent fields. For each how-to give a minimal JSON snippet, where it goes, and how to validate it (POST /config/validate, then save with If-Match using the current version/ETag; explain 412/conflict behaviour only if the code does it). AI settings: describe provider options exactly as the schema allows, and state plainly that no real Vertex runs have been made if that is true. Admin walkthrough: exact URLs and demo users from docs/setup.md. Common mistakes: schema violations, missing If-Match, show-if referencing unknown question ids, STP threshold units, es translations missing, etc. - verify each against the validator. Pitfall: do not claim capabilities (e.g. hot reload, SSO) without checking code. No other files.

verdicts.reason: All criteria met: 24/25 snippets verbatim from tenant files (25th is a validate response example), how-tos, validate/If-Match/console/mistakes covered, claims match src; docs-only
